description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

About the job

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

In this role, you'll be...

Your responsibilities:


Design and implement initiatives to acquire new drivers, being able to leverage data for the decision making process.
Manage the launch and execution of incentives, projects, communications and product developments needed for driver acquisition, ensuring efficiency and expansion.
Be primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, managing expectations and prioritizing operations to deliver results, whilst constantly working along cross-functional teams (Marketing, Legal, City Operations, Product, etc).
Define and manage data dashboards to monitor national performance of driver acquisition and our results.
Ownership of driver acquisition incentives, across multiple countries in Spanish Speaking LatAm.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The successful applicant:


Bachelor's Degree: Engineering, Data Science, Actuary or any related field.
Growth / Marketplace experience: Experimental Testing, User Acquisition, Conversion, Habit Loops, PMF, GTM, Communication Strategies, Marketplace Balance, Pricing, etc
Resilient: proven to be self-motivated, self-directed, and eager to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
User Centric: understanding the needs, motivation and detractors of ride-hailing Drivers to link with our Value Proposition.
Problem Solver with unique strength towards identifying bottlenecks and coming up with creative solutions.
Data-driven core: passion for data analytics and programming, with knowledge/experience in SQL (Nice to have: Python, R, etc.). Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets) are a must. Comfortable about learning and using new software tools.
Effective communication skills. Proficiency in English & Spanish. We're an international team!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Role: Social Community Manager

Location: Av. Paseo de La Reforma, Cuauhtémoc, 06500 Ciudad de México, CDMX, México.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Based in Mexico City as part of OLIVER's LATAM in-house studio, you'll be the front-line specialist responsible for community engagement, brand voice, and real-time social presence across a portfolio of leading household brands. From always-on publishing and reactive cultural moments to creator collaborations and community insight, you'll help ensure these brands show up consistently, authentically, and at the right moment.

THE ROLE:

This isn't a scheduling role. It's a community-first role: One that sits at the intersection of brand voice, social culture, and genuine human connection.

You'll manage the day-to-day social presence of a leading household brand portfolio in Mexico, monitoring platforms, responding to communities, identifying cultural moments, and coordinating content delivery with the wider studio team. You understand what makes Mexican audiences stop scrolling, and you know how to apply a brand's tone of voice in a way that feels platform-native rather than corporate.

We're looking for someone organised and fast-moving, with a real passion for social and a genuine feel for Mexican digital culture.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Community Engagement & Brand Voice

Write and review social copy across platforms, ensuring tone of voice is compelling, authentic to each brand, and tailored to each platform's conventions
Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and mentions in real time — handling community questions and feedback with speed and care
Execute surprise and delight initiatives that build brand loyalty and reward community participation
Identify, engage, and build relationships with brand advocates and key community members; surface user-generated content opportunities for the wider team

Content Planning & Cultural Moments

Monitor cultural conversations, trending topics, and viral formats daily — flagging relevant moments to the team and acting on them while they're still relevant

Monitoring, Insight & Reporting

Use social analytics tools to track performance and support data-informed content decisions
Manage newsroom operations and contribute to weekly brand meetings with marketing stakeholders

Solid experience in social media management, with a focus on organic social for consumer brands — ideally in household, FMCG, personal care, or consumer goods categories

Experience managing social content calendars across multiple platforms, balancing proactive planning and reactive content at pace
Experience coordinating with content creators, influencer partners, and creative teams to deliver social content on time and on brief
Experience using social analytics and reporting tools to track performance and inform content decisions
Clear, organised communication skills, with the ability to contribute to client-facing updates and presentations
A genuine feel for Mexican social culture, digital trends, and the everyday rhythms of household and consumer life
Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines without losing sight of quality

Gen AI & Agentic Thinking

Proficiency with Gen AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grammarly) to support content ideation, copywriting, trend research, and reporting
Experience building personal AI workflows to improve efficiency and quality across a multi-platform workload
Ability to critically evaluate AI outputs and apply human judgement to ensure brand accuracy and authentic audience engagement

We combine advanced AI video technology with deep automotive expertise to deliver innovative content solutions for the automotive industry. Our mission is to transform how vehicles are marketed and sold by creating smarter, more engaging, and more efficient digital experiences. We are looking for an Operations Executive based in Mexico to support our local market operations, client success, and the development of scalable digital and social media operating processes within the automotive industry.




Job Responsibilities:

Responsible for market operations in Mexico and for establishing and improving social media operation SOPs within the automotive industry, covering both new and used vehicles, including but not limited to TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant local platforms, to create standardized operational processes and best practices.
Conduct in-depth research on the Mexican automotive market, consumer behaviour, and digital trends. Continuously optimize social media strategies and execution plans based on new and used vehicle business scenarios, while building scalable and replicable operational systems to improve client performance and market competitiveness.
Provide operational guidance, training, and data analysis to help clients maximize the use of AiMotion's products, improve customer acquisition capabilities, increase lead conversion rates, and support sales growth.

This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

Marketing Operations Specialist

Full Time | Remote or Hybrid (Aguascalientes, MX)

Innovate with Benchmark Digital as a Marketing Operations Specialist

Everyone wants to make the world a better place.

We work to make it happen.

By joining Benchmark Gensuite and exploring careers in the EHS, Sustainability, and ESG Disclosure Reporting space, you'll be helping customers throughout the business community empower informed decision-making, improve employee safety, and lessen their environmental footprint while creating a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Benchmark Gensuite jobs play a crucial role in helping develop our unified EHS, Sustainability, and ESG digital transformation software solutions that enable cross-functional performance excellence, enhance businesses' sustainability efforts, and help them achieve their ESG goals.

With our incredible global team, the collaborative spirit of our subscribers and partners, and the continuous innovation in exciting new technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and IoT, a career at Benchmark Gensuite means you will continuously use and evolve your skills to develop fresh ideas and initiatives.

About The Role

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Specialist to join our Marketing & Business Development team, reporting to the Associate Director, Marketing & Growth Automation.

This hands‐on role will support the day‐to‐day execution and reliability of our marketing automation engine—from translating campaign briefs into emails, forms, landing pages, calls‐to‐action, workflows, and audience segments to maintaining clean data and actionable reporting.

The role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable systems, improving messy processes, and growing into broader marketing operations ownership.

What You'll Do

Campaign & Workflow Automation

Build, launch, monitor, and optimize HubSpot campaigns, workflows, nurture programs, segmentation, and tracking.

Maintain campaign organization, naming conventions, templates, and subscription types.

Support customer marketing programs, including newsletters, onboarding, renewals, win‐back, surveys, adoption, and events.

Monitor email deliverability and compliance, escalating technical issues as needed.

AI-Assisted Campaign Creation

Use approved AI tools to accelerate drafting, personalization, testing, and campaign production.

Apply human review for accuracy, brand alignment, data use, and quality.

Identify responsible opportunities to automate campaign work with appropriate controls.

Reporting & Analytics

Build HubSpot dashboards for campaign, funnel, pipeline, attribution, and ROI performance.

Deliver regular reporting, identify trends and anomalies, and maintain UTM/tracking standards.

Systems & Data Hygiene

Maintain HubSpot data quality, properties, segmentation, account hierarchies, and database organization.

Monitor integrations across HubSpot, CRM, ZoomInfo, Zapier, Chili Piper, and AI tools; troubleshoot and coordinate issue resolution.

Document processes, standardize fields, and manage HubSpot access and permissions.

Growth Experimentation

Build, QA, and document A/B tests across emails, landing pages, and forms.

Track learnings and support conversion rate optimization across the funnel.

HubSpot Requirements

Specialist-level HubSpot Marketing Hub proficiency, including workflows, segmentation, data management, troubleshooting, and reporting.

HubSpot Marketing Hub Software Certification preferred at hire and required within 90 days.

Additional HubSpot certifications are a plus.

Required Experience & Qualifications

3+ years of hands‐on experience using HubSpot, preferably HubSpot Marketing Hub in a B2B SaaS, technology, or similarly complex B2B environment

Demonstrated experience independently building, managing, testing, and troubleshooting HubSpot workflows and marketing automation

Strong experience with HubSpot email marketing, campaigns, contact management, lists, segmentation, forms, landing pages, calls‐to‐action, and reporting

Experience executing automated email, nurture, lifecycle, customer marketing, product adoption, or event campaigns

Working knowledge of CRM and marketing database concepts, including contact properties, lifecycle stages, segmentation, data hygiene, lead management, and campaign attribution

Experience reviewing campaign performance and using data to identify optimization opportunities and explain findings clearly

Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to perform campaign quality assurance before launch

Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast‐paced, deadline‐driven environment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting customer marketing, customer engagement, product adoption, or lifecycle campaigns

Proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal (B2-C1).

Experience using AI tools to support campaign development, personalization, analysis, and execution with appropriate human review

Experience with CRM integrations, marketing data management, ZoomInfo, Chili Piper, Zapier, or similar marketing technology

Familiarity with lead management and Marketing‐to‐Sales or Business Development handoffs

Experience working with distributed or global teams and supporting global or multi‐region marketing programs

Exposure to multi‐touch attribution frameworks

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

About the job

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

Our fast-growing company is looking to add a Senior Marketing Specialist to a role that plays a central part in our operations. The right person will bring a mix of solid technical background and genuine creative marketing experience to support the rollout of high-performing campaigns for a business that values speed and responsiveness. You'll be working alongside people who take real pride in what they build and who actively help each other grow professionally. This opportunity works well for anyone who enjoys pairing technical strength with strategic marketing thinking, and it offers a clear runway for advancing your career over time.

Responsibilities


Shape and polish email layouts and landing page designs that adapt smoothly to different devices, working through the modular tools Marketo provides
Apply working HTML/CSS skills to diagnose formatting issues, tidy up text presentation, and keep displays reliable across numerous email programs and screen configurations
Translate Figma design assets into email builds that render correctly regardless of which client the recipient uses
Design and maintain landing pages, intake forms, and reusable modular pieces in Marketo that shorten the build process for later campaigns
Set up and manage automated engagement sequences and segmented audience groups in Marketo to fulfill a range of campaign purposes
Launch a mix of campaign types, from one-time email pushes to layered drip sequences and event or webinar promotion messaging
Take responsibility for building out campaign pieces like merge fields, dynamic blocks, and program frameworks, keeping in line with Marketo's guidelines around naming and folder structure
Assist with keeping the database in good shape, managing contact details, and coordinating with the operations side on how leads get scored and routed
Monitor how successfully emails reach inboxes, how well they display, and how accurately links get tracked, while reviewing ongoing figures such as open rates, click numbers, opt-outs, and bounces
Complete thorough reviews of each email prior to launch to verify correct rendering, functioning links, and properly filled personalization content
Design and oversee split-test campaigns that evaluate factors like subject line variations, sender identity, layout differences, and timing for optimal delivery
Put together well-defined contact segments using Marketo's audience segmentation features and custom filters, all while keeping compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM intact and preserving data quality
Confirm every piece of marketing material carries the right UTM tags and functioning tracking links
Collaborate with marketing, design, content, and campaign professionals to pin down project needs and steer materials through review and sign-off stages
Manage the timeline and scheduling responsibilities for email and campaign work in a marketing department that operates at a constant, high pace
Keep organized records of build techniques, coding standards, and template collections to help colleagues get up to speed faster and work more effectively
Offer input on new Marketo capabilities and shifting industry approaches to continually raise the bar on campaign results


Requirements


At least three years of direct experience building and overseeing campaigns using Adobe Marketo Engage, with Marketo Certified Professional or Associate certification counted as a bonus, or equivalent experience on platforms like HubSpot or Salesforce
Comfortable command of HTML/CSS, with specific attention to how rendering varies from one email client to another
Hands-on background working with email testing tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid
Strong familiarity with what influences deliverability, methods for maintaining sender reputation, and compliance standards like CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CASL
Capable of both designing and analyzing results from A/B testing efforts
Track record of converting fixed design drafts into functional, brand-consistent email formats
Detail-oriented approach paired with steady, reliable QA practices
Comfortable juggling several email builds at once while meeting demanding deadlines in a high-tempo workplace
Solid English ability, both spoken and written, at a B2 proficiency level or higher


We offer

Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers

Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses

title: Especialista
skills: Bachillerato o Licenciatura en Ingeniería de Software o carrera afín.

Experiencia: +3 años liderando proyectos de Business Intelligence y Analítica de Datos.
Hands-on AWS: Dominio de Amazon Quick (creación de análisis, datasets, SPICE, embedded analytics).
Fundamentos de Datos: Sólidos conocimientos en SQL, modelado de datos y Data Warehousing.
Ecosistema Cloud: Familiaridad con servicios de datos en AWS (Athena, Glue, Redshift, S3).
Certificaciones (Deseables): AWS Certified Data Analytics - Specialty o AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
Diseño y desarrollo de dashboards: Dominio en la creación de visualizaciones claras, reportes paginados (Paginated Reports), análisis interactivos y diseño UX/UI enfocado en datos.
Gestión del motor SPICE: Optimización de la memoria en caché de QuickSight para carga masiva de datos, cálculo eficiente de campos e ingesta programada.
Analítica avanzada e IA: Configuración de funciones de Machine Learning integradas (ML Insights), detección de anomalías, pronósticos (forecasting) y consultas en lenguaje natural (QuickSight Q).
Embedded Analytics: Integración e incrustación de dashboards en aplicaciones web o portales de clientes mediante APIs y SDKs de AWS.

Seguridad y gobernanza de datos: Configuración de controles de acceso a nivel de fila y columna (Row-Level Security / Column-Level Security), integración con AWS IAM y gestión de permisos/roles de usuarios.
Modelado y consulta de datos: Nivel avanzado en SQL para la creación de vistas, funciones analíticas, agregaciones complejas y diseño de esquemas (estrella y copo de nieve).
Integración con servicios de analítica AWS:
AWS Athena / Amazon Redshift: Para consultas distribuidas y almacenamiento en Data Warehouses.
Amazon S3 / AWS Glue: Para almacenamiento en Data Lake, preparación de datos y catálogo de metadatos (ETL/ELT).
Amazon RDS / Aurora: Conexión y consulta a bases de datos relacionales.
Optimización de costos y rendimiento: Capacidad para reducir la latencia de las consultas y gestionar eficientemente las capacidades/licencias de QuickSight y el cómputo subyacente.
Traducción de requerimientos de negocio: Habilidad para entender las necesidades de los stakeholders y convertirlas en métricas financieras, operativas o comerciales (KPIs).
Storytelling con datos: Capacidad para estructurar la información de manera narrativa y visualmente intuitiva para facilitar la toma de decisiones ejecutivas.
Comunicación técnica y funcional: Aptitud para dialogar eficazmente tanto con ingenieros de datos como con directivos o usuarios finales sin perfil técnico.
description:

·  Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar tableros interactivos y reportes analíticos utilizando Amazon QuickSight.

· Integrar Quick con orígenes de datos en AWS (Amazon Redshift, Athena, S3, PostgreSQL, RDS) y fuentes de terceros.

· Configurar modelos de datos optimizados, métricas calculadas y niveles de seguridad (RLS/CLS).

· Coloborar con clientes corporativos para transformar datos complejos en decisiones estratégicas.

Diseño y desarrollo de dashboards: Dominio en la creación de visualizaciones claras, reportes paginados (Paginated Reports), análisis interactivos y diseño UX/UI enfocado en datos.

AWS Athena / Amazon Redshift: Para consultas distribuidas y almacenamiento en Data Warehouses.
Amazon S3 / AWS Glue: Para almacenamiento en Data Lake, preparación de datos y catálogo de metadatos (ETL/ELT).

description:
About the job

Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

Your role at Clorox:

We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative S&OP Analyst to support and drive our Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process. In this role, you will partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to develop accurate demand forecasts, improve forecast performance, and enable data-driven business decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, and translate business plans into actionable forecasts.

In this role, you will:

S&OP Process Leadership


Coordinate and support the end-to-end S&OP process.
Facilitate demand, supply, and alignment meetings with key stakeholders.
Ensure adherence to planning timelines, governance, and decision-making processes.
Drive cross-functional alignment on forecasts and business plans.


Demand Planning & Forecasting


Develop and maintain demand forecasts using statistical methods and commercial inputs.
Build annual and fiscal-year demand plans incorporating market insights, promotions, innovation, and growth initiatives.
Evaluate assumptions and recommend forecast adjustments based on business trends and data analysis.
Provide visibility of forecast changes and demand risks.


Forecast Performance Management


Monitor forecast accuracy and forecast bias metrics.
Identify root causes of forecasting errors and recommend corrective actions.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance forecast quality and planning performance.
Deliver actionable insights to stakeholders through regular performance reviews.


Data Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and business risks.
Maintain forecasting databases and planning systems.
Create dashboards and reports to support decision-making.
Ensure data integrity across multiple planning sources.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.
Challenge volume assumptions using data-driven insights.
Support scenario planning and business reviews.
Communicate forecast risks, opportunities, and recommendations to leadership.


What we look for:


Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, related field or equivalent experience.
Experience in Demand Planning, Forecasting, Supply Chain Planning, S&OP, or related functions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

description:
About the job

As a Solutions Engineer at Speechmatics, you’ll play a key role in helping customers successfully evaluate and adopt our industry-leading speech technology. You’ll partner closely with Sales to guide customers through the entire technical journey, from discovery and solution design to proof-of-concept delivery and technical validation.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll build demos, write code, deploy environments, and solve real customer problems.

You’ll also take ownership of selected accounts, helping scale the team’s impact while gaining exposure to global customers across multiple industries. We’ll support you with structured onboarding and training so you can quickly become confident with our technology and customers.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partnering with Sales to lead the technical pre-sales process from discovery to close 
Understanding customer requirements (security, scale, integrations, accuracy, workflows) and designing practical solutions 
Building and delivering technical demos, prototypes, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs) 
Deploying and configuring environments in cloud or on-prem setups for customer evaluations 
Writing scripts or lightweight integrations (Python or JavaScript) to support demos and customer testing 
Troubleshooting customer challenges and guiding them toward successful outcomes 
Delivering engaging technical presentations to customers, partners, and events 
Supporting conferences and showcases globally, including international travel, to deliver compelling technical demonstrations 
Sharing knowledge internally and helping Sales stay up to date as our platform evolves 


Who We’re Looking For


Previous experience working in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Consulting, or similar) 
Hands-on programming ability - ideally Python/JavaScript 
Comfortable working with APIs (REST and WebSocket), integrations, and technical troubleshooting 
Experience deploying or configuring software in cloud, Linux, containers, or networked environments 
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate customer needs into workable solutions 
Confident communicator who enjoys working directly with customers 
Self-motivated, curious, and eager to learn new technologies quickly 
Collaborative mindset and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously 


We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who We Are

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What We Can Offer You

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.

But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.

So, come as you are and join our Speechling community. We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.

For more information on us, please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity 

The Global Procurement Control System Support Associate Manager serves as the primary business liaison between the Global Procurement Control organization and IT teams, supporting critical procurement and control systems that enable global business operations. This role is responsible for ensuring the stability, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of key business applications, while driving automation, process enhancements, and digital transformation initiatives.

The position supports day-to-day business operations, system administration, user support, project execution, and controls-related activities. The role will partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Procurement, Planning, Control, and IT to identify solutions, improve processes, and deliver strategic system implementations.

Your Impact 

Serve as the functional liaison between business users and IT teams for Global Procurement and Control applications, including CCDS, T-Forms, QuickBase, CMS, Business Objects, Selectica, and Ariba CLM.

Administer, maintain, and support critical procurement and control systems to ensure ongoing operational effectiveness.

Manage user access, permissions, licensing, and system governance across supported platforms.

Lead issue resolution efforts by coordinating with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors.

Identify and implement automation opportunities, process improvements, and system enhancements that drive efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Support system upgrades, testing, user acceptance activities, implementations, and post-deployment stabilization efforts.

Partner with cross-functional teams to execute strategic projects and digital transformation initiatives across Global Procurement.

Develop and maintain process documentation, training materials, and user guides.

Create and enhance dashboards, metrics, and reporting solutions to improve business visibility and decision-making.

Support controls-related activities, including system access management, cyclical application controls, master data maintenance, and accounting close support processes.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience supporting business applications, systems administration, process improvement, or IT business partnership functions.

Experience working with ERP systems, such as SAP, and business applications in a corporate environment.

Experience participating in system implementations, testing, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.

Strong knowledge of business systems, applications, and reporting tools.

Experience Supporting Enterprise Applications Is Preferred.

Understanding of IT support processes, system governance, access controls, and application lifecycle management.

Experience leveraging AI and technology solutions to improve business processes, reporting, and analysis.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess risks and develop practical solutions.

Leadership and Professional Skills

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences and business requirements for technical teams.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.

Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels.

About the job

Role Title: Video Annotation Specialist




Role Type: Contractor




Location: Remote




micro1 is engaging Video Annotation Specialists to contribute to a unique project focused on annotating video sessions of robotic arms completing various tasks. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.




Scope of Work

Review video footage of robotic arms performing tasks, following detailed grading guidelines provided by the customer.
Tag and annotate actions, events, and behaviors observed in the video sessions using dedicated annotation tools.
Ensure all annotations are precise, consistent, and accurately reflect the activity taking place within each video segment.
Collaborate with project stakeholders and other contributors to clarify annotation requirements and resolve ambiguities.
Document observations clearly and communicate findings in written form, adhering to predefined project templates and protocols.
Contribute to quality control by reviewing peer annotations and providing constructive feedback when requested.

Contact clients following closed support cases to check in, assess satisfaction, and gather direct qualitative feedback on their resolution experience.
Function as an empathetic, professional liaison between clients and internal leadership, identifying trends in customer feedback to inform overall Support operations.




General Support & Operational Duties:

Perform additional operational and administrative duties as assigned to support evolving business requirements.

Strong functional knowledge of Salesforce Service Cloud, standard administration principles, case management, layouts, standard flow/automation concepts, and platform capabilities.

Immediate hiring

About the job

Al vez usted puede ser nuestro nuevo

 Customer Service Quality Specialist

Responsabilidades Clave


Asistir y brindar soporte a los clientes en la gestión de no conformidades (RNC) identificadas por los clientes, directamente relacionadas con la planta (QA) y el área de procesos (QE), de acuerdo con el proceso SIG ICCM.

Apoyar la implementación de los módulos del pilar de Mantenimiento de Calidad, siguiendo los lineamientos del Sistema de Excelencia SIG.
Actuar de manera proactiva y sostenible, manteniéndose consciente de los impactos ambientales derivados de sus actividades y buscando minimizarlos, así como comprometiéndose con la política ambiental establecida por la empresa para asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares SIG.
Cumplir y trabajar de acuerdo con las normas de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP) para garantizar la producción de empaques seguros para clientes y consumidores, así como ejecutar correctamente todos los procedimientos de calidad bajo su responsabilidad para asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares de SIG.


Usted trae estas habilidades, experiencia & educación


Licenciatura en Ingenieria Quimica, Alimentos, Procesos Industriales o Industrial

Excel Avanzado
SAP Intermedio

Lean Management

Resolucion de Problemas Avanzado 
Atencion y Servicio al Cliente Avanzado
ISO/BRC GS/FDA Intermedio


Experiencia en años

3 - 5 años en un puesto similar en Customer Service Quality

Competencias SIG

Estamos buscando personas que estén dispuestas a lograr resultados de manera constante, incluso en circunstancias difíciles, empleados que creen un clima en el que todos estén motivados para hacer lo mejor que puedan para ayudar a la organización a lograr sus objetivos. Si busca activamente nuevas formas de crecer y ser desafiado, si desarrolla personas para alcanzar tanto sus metas profesionales como las metas de la organización, SIG es el lugar para usted. Para brindar mejores servicios a nuestros clientes, nuestros futuros colegas construyen relaciones sólidas con los clientes y brindan soluciones centradas en el cliente. Finalmente, estamos buscando colegas que construyan asociaciones y trabajen en colaboración con otros para alcanzar objetivos compartidos. ¿Es usted alguien que aplica el conocimiento de los negocios y el mercado para avanzar en los objetivos de la organización? ¿Es usted alguien que puede crear nuevas y mejores formas para que la organización tenga éxito? Si la respuesta es "sí", ven y únase a nosotros.

Nuestra promesa

SIG es el lugar para que construyas algo increíble. Ofrecemos una compensación competitiva y la oportunidad de trabajar parcialmente desde casa. Si se une a nosotros, será parte de una empresa internacional de éxito mundial, que lidera su industria en sostenibilidad, tecnología y más. Nos consideramos la plataforma de lanzamiento profesional: un lugar para desarrollarse rápidamente con trabajo real, experiencia real, oportunidades reales para desarrollar habilidades. Formarás parte de un equipo altamente motivado y dinámico, tendrás oportunidades de desarrollo personal, capacitaciones y oportunidades de entrenamiento de parte de miembros senior del equipo. Si demuestras habilidad y ganas de aprender, te apoyaremos en todo momento.

Acera de SIG

SIG es un proveedor líder de sistemas y soluciones de envasado for better. Trabajamos en colaboración con nuestros clientes para llevar productos alimenticios a los consumidores de todo el mundo de forma segura, sostenible y asequible. Somos el único proveedor de sistemas de envasado que cubre envases de cartón, pouch y bag-in-box. Nuestra tecnología versátil y nuestra capacidad de innovación de productos nos permiten brindar mejores servicios a los clientes, a los consumidores y al mundo. La sustentabilidad nos guía, la tecnología nos empodera, pero es la pasión y el impulso de nuestra gente lo que realmente nos permite brindar mejores resultados. Fundada en 1853, SIG tiene su sede en Neuhausen, Suiza, y cotiza en SIX Swiss Exchange.

description:
About the job

About Us

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

We are not a fund. We are a club. No blind pools, no lock-ups, no marketing dressed up as deal flow. Every member chooses what they back, and we handle everything else - sourcing, diligence, SPV formation, legal, reporting, and the live community that makes the whole thing run.

What You Will Do:

The CRM Coordinator is the operational backbone of our member and prospect pipeline. You will own the integrity and performance of our CRM - ensuring every contact, deal stage, and communication touchpoint is accurate, timed, and purposeful.

This is not a data-entry role. We need someone who understands why the data matters, takes ownership of process breakdowns before anyone else notices them, and continuously improves how we track and engage our community. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations to ensure no relationship falls through the cracks.

What You'll Own


 CRM Administration & Data Integrity
Own day-to-day administration of HubSpot: contact records, deal stages, pipeline accuracy, custom properties, and lifecycle stages
Maintain a single source of truth for all member and prospect data - clean, current, and actionable
Proactively identify and resolve duplicate records, data anomalies, and process gaps before they surface as problems
 Workflows, Sequences & Automation
Build and maintain workflows, sequences, and automations that support member acquisition, engagement, and retention
Coordinate with the Partner/Origination and Managing Partner teams to ensure pipeline data reflects real-time activity
Continuously improve the CRM architecture as the club scales - new pipelines, new stages, new segments
 Reporting & Funnel Insights
Track and report on key funnel metrics: applications, conversions, member tenure, engagement signals, and re-engagement triggers
Surface insights to leadership in a clear, concise format - no noise, just signal
Build and maintain dashboards that give the team visibility into pipeline health at a glance
 List Segmentation & Campaign Coordination
Own audience segmentation and list management for outreach campaigns coordinated with the Director of Community & Operations
Ensure the right message reaches the right segment at the right time - and that results are tracked cleanly
 Member Onboarding Flows
Support the operational layer of new member onboarding - ensuring the right communications go out on schedule and that member records are updated as they move through each stage
Liaise with the Director of Community & Operations to keep onboarding workflows current and optimised


Requirements

Who You Are:


2+ years of hands-on CRM or revenue operations experience, with HubSpot as a hard requirement
You have a strong grasp of sales pipeline management, lifecycle stages, and funnel reporting - not just where to find them in a dashboard, but what they mean
You can build workflows and sequences without hand-holding. You know when automation helps and when it creates more problems than it solves
You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice when something is off, and you fix it before being asked
You are async-first and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, distributed team across time zones
You communicate clearly and concisely - in writing, always


Bonus Points


Experience in financial services, investment communities, high-ticket sales, or private membership organisations
Familiarity with Web3, DeFi, or crypto-adjacent audiences
Exposure to SPV workflows, investor relations, or regulated communications
Experience with ClickUp, Slack automation, or n8n


How We Work


Inflection Club's leadership operates on a Yin-Yang model borrowed from how our founders built Decentralized Masters. Every major initiative gets multiple sets of eyes before it ships. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations and surface issues early. You will own your domain. And you will be expected to set the quality bar - not wait for it to be set for you
We move quickly. We do not tolerate sloppiness. We expect the CRM to be a tool that makes the team faster and sharper, not a system people work around


Benefits


Fully remote - work from anywhere
Flexible, async-first culture with deep focus time built in
Competitive independent contractor rate commensurate with experience
Direct exposure to institutional-grade deal flow and a high-calibre investor community
Ground-floor opportunity in a private co-investment club being built to scale


Are You Ready?

This is a rare opportunity to own the operational intelligence layer of a private investment community that is growing fast and playing for the long game. If you are the kind of person who finds broken processes and fixes them before being asked - and who wants to be part of something being built to last - we want to hear from you.

Apply with your CV in English, along with a brief note on the CRM system you know best and one process improvement you have owned end-to-end. We move quickly and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates within two weeks.

description:
About the job

About Improvado

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

What we sell: extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

Who buys it:


Economic buyers: CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
Technical evaluators: VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
Segments: enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
Verticals: pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies


Why this role, now


Our messaging is not aligned. Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price
The category is crowded and moving fast. Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true
Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving
Analyst firms are a silent blocker. When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them


You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

What you'll own


Positioning and messaging. Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it
Competitive intelligence and win/loss. A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning
Sales enablement. The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays
Market and analyst relations. The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization


What we're looking for


4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product
Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak
B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile
Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards reps actually opened, a win/loss program that survived past its second quarter
Writing that survives contact with a skeptical technical buyer — claim and evidence, not adjective stacking
Comfort operating close to Sales: weekly cadence, deal reviews, live calls, direct feedback


Nice to have: hands-on SQL, dbt or BI, enough to validate a claim yourself. Experience marketing AI capabilities without hype. Analyst-relations experience. Agency-side or enterprise-brand background. Vertical depth in pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, or gaming.

Not a fit if: your product marketing has been mostly launch logistics and content calendars; you need a fully staffed team and a finished brand system to be effective; you are uncomfortable being told in a deal review that your messaging did not work.

How we measure success


Win rate in competitive deals against our top 3 named competitors, baseline set in month 1
Stage-to-stage conversion on open opportunities, particularly discovery to demo to proposal
Time-to-first-deal for new reps
Field adoption of enablement assets — measured, not assumed
Win/loss program running on cadence, with themes that visibly change product and GTM decisions
Message consistency: a quarterly audit across web, deck, product UI and content


What We Offer

description:
About the job

Associate (Intern) - General Merchandise 

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.


Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. 
Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. 
Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. 
Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. 
Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. 
Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 


What will you be doing? 

This internship is designed for students to get hands-on, real-world experience working with a Client Development Team. The internship is for rising year 3 students, interested in pursuing a career in Insights, Analytics, CPG, Retail, Gen Merch or Market Research post-graduation.

Circana offers a full program to ensure ALL our associates gain:


Knowledge about the industry we exist in and the clients we serve. 
Experience working on active projects that have actual impact on our business. 
Training on technical tools and behavioral skills that are critical to an employee’s success. 
Networking and mentor opportunities that can create personal connections. 


Job Responsibilities


Support a team responsible for helping a General Merchandise client (or multiple clients) understand their performance relative to the market and identify opportunities to grow their business and share of the market. 
Understand how to leverage Circana analytics to address clients’ business challenges and market opportunities. 
Translate data into actionable, analytic insights to drive Circana’s clients’ business performance. 
Shadow client meetings to present market research and insights. 
At Circana lateral, promotional, and cross-functional moves are encouraged and part of our culture. While your initial role will be in one of these groups, you’ll have the chance to grow your career both within your initial assignment and into other opportunities that meet your career goals. 


Requirements


Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree required in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field with a quantitative component, expecting to graduate between June 2027 and December 2027. 
Experience in or knowledge of the Retail or CPG industry preferred (e.g., School projects, case study, or relevant work experience). 
Academic knowledge/coursework in finance, economics, statistics, marketing or marketing analytics, data visualization, and/or logic is preferred. 
Strong intellectual curiosity and critical thinking ability, relentless attention to detail, strong written/verbal communication, ability to work collaboratively on a team, etc. 
Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus but not essential. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, etc.)
Technology aptitude and willingness to learn and work on new solutions and platforms. 
Creative problem-solving skills, ability to frame a business problem, design and execute an analysis plan, and understand and synthesize data findings into business insights and translate into creative data visualizations. 


Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:


Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 


Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid, Mexico City, Mexico

description:
About the job

Desarrollador Full Stack

¿Te apasiona desarrollar aplicaciones modernas y escalables? ¿Disfrutas resolver desafíos técnicos y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios? ¡Únete a Aon y contribuye al desarrollo de soluciones digitales innovadoras para nuestros clientes!

Esta es una posición híbrida con flexibilidad para trabajar de manera virtual y desde nuestra oficina de Ciudad de México, de acuerdo con la política de Smart Working de Aon.

Aon está en el negocio de tomar mejores decisiones

En Aon, damos forma a las decisiones para proteger y enriquecer la vida de las personas alrededor del mundo.

Como organización, estamos unidos a través de la confianza como un equipo inclusivo y diverso, y nos apasiona ayudar a nuestros colegas y clientes a alcanzar el éxito.

Cómo será el día típico

Como Desarrollador Full Stack, serás responsable de diseñar, desarrollar y dar soporte a aplicaciones web y soluciones basadas en la nube. Colaborarás con equipos de tecnología, producto, diseño y negocio durante todo el ciclo de desarrollo, transformando requerimientos en soluciones tecnológicas seguras, eficientes y escalables.


Diseñar, desarrollar, probar y mantener componentes de front-end y back-end para aplicaciones web y en la nube.
Desarrollar e integrar APIs, servicios, bases de datos y funcionalidades orientadas al usuario.
Colaborar con responsables de producto, analistas de negocio y diseñadores de experiencia e interfaz de usuario para convertir requerimientos y prototipos en soluciones funcionales.
Participar en ceremonias ágiles, planeación técnica, estimación de esfuerzos, revisión de código y actividades de mejora continua.
Investigar incidentes en producción, realizar análisis de causa raíz e implementar soluciones confiables.
Desarrollar pruebas automatizadas y apoyar los procesos de integración y despliegue continuos.
Elaborar documentación técnica y asegurar que las soluciones cumplan con los estándares establecidos de seguridad, rendimiento y calidad.


Cómo se diferencia esta oportunidad

Esta posición ofrece la oportunidad de contribuir al desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas dentro de una organización global de servicios profesionales. Colaborarás con equipos multidisciplinarios y de diferentes países, mientras adquieres exposición a retos de negocio relacionados con riesgos, seguros, salud y capital humano.

Formarás parte de un entorno en el que se valoran las nuevas ideas y podrás ampliar tus conocimientos técnicos, participar en proyectos de modernización tecnológica y desarrollar soluciones que mejoren la experiencia de los clientes y colegas de Aon.

Habilidades y experiencia que te llevarán al éxito


Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web Full Stack utilizando tecnologías como C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular o React.
Experiencia en el desarrollo e integración de APIs REST, microservicios y bases de datos relacionales o no relacionales.
Conocimiento de plataformas en la nube, preferentemente Microsoft Azure, así como experiencia con integración continua, despliegue continuo, control de versiones y automatización.
Conocimiento de patrones de diseño, desarrollo seguro, pruebas automatizadas, metodologías ágiles y ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software.
Sólidas habilidades de análisis, comunicación y resolución de problemas, con capacidad para colaborar en inglés con equipos técnicos y áreas de negocio.


Educación: Licenciatura o ingeniería en Ciencias de la Computación, Desarrollo de Software, Tecnologías de la Información o una disciplina relacionada. También se considerarán años equivalentes de experiencia profesional.

Cómo apoyamos a nuestros colegas

Además de nuestro paquete integral de beneficios, promovemos una fuerza laboral diversa. Nuestro entorno ágil e inclusivo permite gestionar el bienestar y el equilibrio entre la vida personal y profesional, asegurando que cada colega pueda dar lo mejor de sí mismo en Aon.

Todos nuestros colegas disfrutan de dos Global Wellbeing Days cada año, destinados a tomarse un tiempo para enfocarse en su bienestar.

Ofrecemos diferentes soluciones de trabajo y reconocemos que la flexibilidad va más allá del lugar desde donde se trabaja. A esto lo llamamos Smart Working.

Nuestra cultura de aprendizaje continuo te inspira y proporciona las herramientas necesarias para aprender, compartir y crecer, ayudándote a alcanzar tu máximo potencial. Como resultado, en Aon estarás más conectado, serás más relevante y te sentirás más valorado.

Aon promueve un lugar de trabajo innovador y diverso, donde todos los colegas se sienten empoderados para mostrarse tal como son. Aon se enorgullece de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades laborales.

Aon no acepta currículums no solicitados por parte de firmas de búsqueda para esta posición. Si eres una firma de búsqueda, no recibirás compensación por presentar a un candidato, incluso si Aon contrata a dicha persona.

Nada de lo señalado en esta descripción restringe el derecho de la compañía a asignar o reasignar las funciones y responsabilidades de esta posición en cualquier momento.

Qualifications

¿A quién buscamos? 


Analítico: descomponer en partes el proceso para obtener una mejor comprensión de este, siendo capaz de solucionar problemas y tomar decisiones basadas en aprendizajes adquiridos a partir de la información y datos recopilados. Tomar decisiones correctas y llegar a conclusiones sólidas.
Capacidad de influencia: inspirar a otras personas a comprometerse con una visión compartida.
Curiosidad por aprender: aprender interna y externamente fuera de la zona de confort, aportando algo positivo a la empresa
Confianza e integridad: Fomenta el dialogo abierto, ser consistente con las palabras y cumplir compromisos. 
Inclusividad y respeto: Crear entornos de trabajo inclusivos donde las personas se sientan alentados y respetados por sus contribuciones. Mostrar interés y comprensión de sus necesidades, motivaciones, desafíos.

Resultados: Toma medidas rápidamente y elimina obstáculos para ofrecer resultados de calidad con el sentido de urgencia correcto.

Perspectivas externas: Demostrar una perspectiva holística de PEPSICO, visualiza problemas y retribuciones desde el punto de vista de toda la cadena al tomar decisiones y crear estrategias. Aprovechar el conocimiento del negocio para impulsar la estrategia e informar la toma de decisiones. 
Pensamiento hacia adelante: Planes a largo plazo que aporten valor. Crear un entorno donde se fomente el pensamiento y la creatividad.
Toma de decisión: Crear una cultura en la que las personas se sientan cómodas tomando riesgos apropiados, aprendiendo de los éxitos o fracasos. 
Conocimiento de idioma inglés

title: Community Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Creador de Contenido para Redes Sociales
description:
About the job

Sobre nosotros

Symmetry es una app de salud y fitness con más de 3 millones de descargas: número uno de fitness en España, top 10 en varios mercados más y más de 200 millones de visualizaciones al mes en nuestros canales de Marketing. Estamos sumando creadores en México para seguir creciendo en la región.




Qué vas a crear

Piezas para redes sociales, con el carrusel como formato principal: varias tarjetas con imagen y texto, pensadas para retener la atención y para que la gente las guarde. Tú te encargas de la pieza completa, desde el concepto y el gancho inicial hasta la última tarjeta.




Tu semana de trabajo

Arrancas revisando qué está funcionando en fitness y bienestar dentro de redes: qué formatos se repiten, qué ganchos retienen y qué está saturado. 

Con eso armas propuestas y las llevas al Head of Content. Una vez validadas, produces siguiendo la línea editorial del equipo, registras tu trabajo en las herramientas internas y ajustas con el feedback de la revisión semanal.




Qué necesitas

Criterio para redes: distingues un gancho que funciona de uno que no y sabes explicar por qué. Manejo de formato vertical y de las herramientas para producirlo; con tu celular y computadora es suficiente. Escritura corta y precisa, porque el copy es la mitad de un buen carrusel. Capacidad de recibir feedback y aplicarlo rápido. Interés real por el fitness, la salud o el bienestar.




Suma puntos

Cuentas o piezas propias que podamos ver, sin importar el tamaño de la audiencia. Experiencia produciendo contenido orgánico con calendario y volumen sostenido. Conocer la escena de creadores de fitness y bienestar en México.




Cómo trabajamos

Trabajo remoto al cien por ciento y horario flexible: lo que cuenta es el contenido que sale, no el horario en que lo produces. Reportas directo al Head of Content, con metas definidas cada semana y una sesión de revisión para iterar sobre lo publicado.




Compensación y formato

Compensación competitiva, acorde a experiencia y dedicación. Posición remota desde México. Si el encaje funciona, existe camino de crecimiento dentro del equipo de contenido.




Tu candidatura

Mándanos trabajo que ya tengas publicado: tu TikTok, Instagram, carruseles, videos, lo que sea. Si todavía no tienes nada publicado, mándanos tres cuentas que te parezcan bien hechas y dinos exactamente qué hacen bien.
